scenes.heading: Building an efficient outreach system instead of one-off pitches

sents.d: Building an efficient outreach system instead of one-off pitches
A repeatable outreach process gets you more deals than sporadically pitching when you remember to.

Keeping a simple running list of target brands (with notes on who to contact, what you pitched, and when) prevents outreach from being a sporadic, easily-forgotten task and turns it into a consistent pipeline.
Batching outreach — a set number of pitches sent on a regular schedule, rather than only when you happen to have downtime — produces far more consistent deal flow than reactive, occasional pitching.
Tracking response rates by pitch style or brand type over time reveals what's actually working, so you can do more of what converts instead of guessing.

take: Run outreach as a steady, tracked pipeline.
